title: Official AudioBus routing, silent exclusion, and analysis gain protection
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: SetAudioBusRoutes applies the intended audio bus DAG and optional audio trackBusIds as one group. A cycle (AUDIO_ROUTE_CYCLE), reciprocal mismatch, or FIELD_LOCKED retarget of a locked audio track leaves the document unchanged; no subset of the routes is committed. Official admission allows a bounded DAG (≤64 buses, no bus effectIds). SetMasterAudio updates only the master bus and keeps sibling buses.

Muted official audio tracks and domain PcmInput.silent/muted inputs are omitted from compileOfficialMixInputs and mix48k; they are not mixed into the master. Export and playback segment builders pass the track busId and already skip muted tracks.

AnalysisGainPlayback.apply plans ducking as a separate AUTO layer and adds it to manual dB at playback. Manual gain points are never rewritten (mutations=0). trackLocked/gainLocked refuse the whole application (TRACK_LOCKED/MANUAL_LOCKED) and leave the document and manual envelope unchanged.

Source-anchored gain cues are sampled with GainEnvelope.atTimeline through already-admitted linear timeMap/rate only. This slice does not time-stretch PCM, open I-007 remapping or nest, start I-060/V-024 limiter, change Pulse startup scheduling, or claim I-023 complete. Increment 1.17/1.18 stay open. Video and caption mute/solo stay FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState; syncLock is not toggled. New-track, independent audio import, bus Effect persist, official clip gain Effect writes, invert-matrix rows, caption export, and cross-device/RTC are not in this slice.
